cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Say the Scary Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to name the frightening possibility or vulnerable feeling before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before our skating qualifier, can you say the possibility we keep avoiding? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want you carrying that onto the ice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'm carrying it already. I just need you to say it first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We might not qualify. I'd still want to skate with you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why did I need that second sentence so much? Could you name that fear too?

mechanism: A organizes the moments before a qualifier but accommodates B protective reluctance to secure B first naming the shared fear.
confusable: Unlike simply seeking encouragement, A insists B speak the avoided possibility; confidence is maintained by letting B set a reassuring condition.
comparison: Two skaters face imminent performance, unlike a shopkeeper confronting family responsibility through a letter.
seedUse: Use D104-b qualification fear and continuing partnership; S02-b adapts the proposed method after partner objection.
